source.min_speed_floor_note: On ugrp1 (white_desk, ~7.55 V), minimum legal board speed 35 already moves 15.49 mm/0.10s (vs sim 0.33..0.39 = 10.64..14.76 mm/0.10s; sim 0.40 = 15.71 mm -> 35.2). Because real_robot/calibration.py enforces BOARD_MIN_ABS_SPEED=35 and rejects out-of-range sim magnitudes, 0.33..0.39 are mapped to hardware minimum 35.0 (+0.73..+4.85 mm/0.10s over sim) so PickBrain/ACT contract 0.31..0.40 executes safely; 0.31..0.32 map to 0 via sim_no_motion_max=0.32.
